concrete_blocker.description: SignalForwardObservationService.sync_forward_outcomes reads existing rows from signal_outcome_measurements without checking if outcome == 'UNRESOLVED'. If a row exists with outcome == 'UNRESOLVED', build_signal_outcome_measurement is skipped, preventing in-flight forward observations from ever resolving when market prices move or signals expire.
